During UCR Leadership Week, MPP students in the Randall Lewis Policy Fellows program will be participating in a panel to share how hands-on experiences in public service have shaped their leadership development, academic journeys, and professional goals.

⭐ Paths to Public Service: Building Leaders for the Common Good
Tuesday, October 20th
11 a.m. - 12 p.m.
HUB 265
Free boba for attendees!🧋

➡️ Register via the link in our bio! 

This is a great opportunity to explore how you can begin developing your own leadership skills as a student and discover where a career in public service could take you.

#UCRSPP #UCR #PublicPolicy #UCRLeadershipWeek #UCRSchoolofPublicPolicy

Thank you so much for coming out to our Meet & Greet and first Community Hour yesterday!! 💞

Join us again next Thursday from 7:00-8:00pm in APSP for our next Community Hour. We’ll be going over how to register to vote, so please come out! 

Our full Resource Access topic schedule can be found on the second slide. Every week, we’ll have a different topic to go over to help you access resources!! You can also just join us to enjoy being in community :) 

See you next Thursday!! 🩵

Facilitated by @dcienjoyer2000 & @s.h0cke 📢
